contrast_contract.change_vs_control: QAT mode only: selected recurrent matrices, plus head matrix for recurrent_head.
contrast_contract.control: same T4, same seed, fold0, same source/data/teacher/objective/EMA, batch16, FP32, AdamW1e-4, one epoch, fixed epoch0, inherited preprocessing; --qat none
contrast_contract.order: preflight, QAT probe, FP32 control fit and export/score, then QAT fit and export/score. Both use seed3 internally; control is not selected by score.
contrast_contract.outputs: separate declared run directories, checkpoints, prediction arrays/metadata, score reports for FP32 control and QAT arm, preflight XML and step reports.
contrast_contract.probe: one production-shape QAT batch per device under isolated distinct run name; no mutation/reuse of scientific run outputs.
contrast_contract.score_use: single-arm fold0 diagnostics; root performs paired control-vs-QAT comparisons after download; no promotion or significance conclusion from the worker.

heartbeat: Current wrapper uses kaggle_gpu_runner.py whitelisted resource heartbeat every30 seconds; no environment or command dumps.
missing_combo_asset: Combo epoch3 checkpoint+provenance are embedded in the bundle because absent from the E413 shared assets dataset.
provider_timeout_application: Root applies 22500s via the established provider command at push; not encoded in kernel metadata.
